_comment: Preloaded historical baselines for ~150 major Indian cities (all capitals + highest-population), derived from 10 years (2016-2025) of Open-Meteo Archive daily data (https://open-meteo.com/, free). clim_temp/clim_precip = 366 day-of-year averages (multi-year baseline); years/annual_temp/annual_precip = per-year values for trend regression. Built by backend/scripts/build_historical_baselines.py; raw daily is not stored. Other cities get their baseline on-demand in the Trend Engine (Sprint 3).
